observation_summary: A unit test expected ShapeUtilities.equal(g1, g2) to return false when g2 starts at a different moveTo; instead it returned true. The failure was due to the equal(...) implementation using the same PathIterator for both inputs.
reasoning_summary: The fix changes a single incorrect assignment: iterator2 was initialized from p1 instead of p2. This is a wrong variable used in an assignment/initialization (not a missing guard, algorithm rewrite, interface change, or concurrency fix). The diff shows only the assignment corrected, so Assignment/Initialization is the best match.
